newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Nafin interest rate for April 26.79 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Nafin interest rate for April 26.79 pct.

text.p: Mexico's state development bank Nacional Financiera (Nafin) on Sunday said its so-called "Tasa Nafin" interest rate for April was set at 26.79 percent.

Nafin recently changed its interest rate policy, setting the Interbank Equilibrium Interest Rate (TIIE) as the base rate for new loans to businesses, but it said it would continue to publish the Tasa Nafin for loans that were originally drawn up using it as the base rate.
It said debtors whose credits are eligible for the Nafin rate can opt either to use it or the TIIE, but they cannot change their decision once it is made.

Nafin said it would charge loans for microbusinesses at TIIE plus zero percentage points, for small businesses at TIIE plus 100 basis points, for medium-sized companies at TIIE plus 200 bps and for large firms at TIIE plus 300 bps.
